description: Search resource deposits by commodity, resource_type, country, status, owner_country, max_port_km or name. `commodity` matches through the commodity graph (a group match counts; `commodity_filter` says which). Returns {count, total, deposits[]}, paged. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

country.description: Country as an ISO code or a name.

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 100. Default 50.

max_port_km.description: Only deposits within this many km of a port.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

owner_country.description: Country of the deposit's owners (their home states), ISO code or name.

resource_type.description: The deposit's primary resource label (exact, case-insensitive).

status.description: Deposit status, e.g. operating, development, exploration.

name: deposits
